2608.07249.title: Stoicheia: Character-Level Masked Diffusion for Ancient Greek Textual Restoration, Parsing, and Metrical Scansion
2608.07249.paper_summary: We introduce Stoicheia, a 405M-parameter character-level masked-diffusion encoder for Ancient Greek whose input factors into five aligned, independently maskable planes: letters, word and sentence boundaries, diacritics, capitalization, and punctuation. A single backbone can therefore restore lacunae, re-segment, accentuate, and punctuate unspaced text without task-specific retokenization. We pretrain it on an open, revision-pinned corpus of 380M words and release eleven checkpoints: ten rotated, decontaminated folds, guaranteeing that for any given literary passage at least one released model has never seen its text, and one with no exposure to documentary texts. Three experiments - reconstruction of damaged inscriptions and papyri, morphosyntactic tagging and dependency parsing, and macronization with metrical scansion - each carry a matched random-initialization control, isolating what character-level diffusion pretraining contributes: 5.6 CER points on inscription reconstruction, 12.9 LAS on parsing, and 6.0 points of balanced accuracy on macronization. On Ithaca's own test split, with identical frozen samples and strict scoring, Stoicheia reduces character error relative to both prior state-of-the-art systems, from 24.6 (Ithaca) and 23.5 (its 2025 Aeneas-framework successor) to 15.5, and raises top-1 accuracy from 63.0 and 64.0 to 74.5.
2608.07249.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹 Stoicheia，一個擁有 405M 參數的字符級掩蔽擴散編碼器，專為古希臘語設計，其輸入分為五個對齊的、可獨立掩蔽的平面：字母、單詞和句子邊界、變音符號、大寫字母和標點符號。因此，單一的主幹可以恢復缺失部分、重新分段、強調和標點未加空格的文本，而無需特定任務的重新標記。我們在一個開放的、經過修訂的 380M 字的語料庫上進行預訓練，並釋出十一個檢查點：十個旋轉的、去污染的摺疊，保證對於任何給定的文學段落，至少有一個釋出的模型從未見過其文本，並且有一個對文獻文本沒有接觸。三個實驗 - 損壞的銘文和紙草書的重建、形態句法標記和依賴解析，以及帶有韻律掃描的長音化 - 每個都帶有匹配的隨機初始化控制，隔離字符級擴散預訓練的貢獻：在銘文重建上提高了 5.6 CER 點，在解析上提高了 12.9 LAS，並在長音化上提高了 6.0 平衡準確率。在伊薩卡自己的測試分割上，使用相同的凍結樣本和嚴格的評分，Stoicheia 將字符錯誤從 24.6（伊薩卡）和 23.5（其 2025 年 Aeneas 框架的繼任者）降低到 15.5，並將 top-1 準確率從 63.0 和 64.0 提高到 74.5。
2608.07249.author: Eric Cullhed et.al.
